## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Only an optional test cleanup was found in the reviewed scope because a complete legacy report already exercises header rejection.

## Changes

The parser now requires the first line to match `REPORT v1` exactly. The pull request adds tests for unsupported headers.

## Critical

(none)

(none)

## Suggestions

- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Remove the ineffective legacy-header test — The fixture `REPORT v1\nversion=v0` returns `None` even with header validation removed because it lacks `END`. The replacement changes the body value and leaves the header at `REPORT v1`. — Maintainers can read the passing test as evidence of legacy-header rejection even though it never checks that behavior.
